name: Serimiya Nonomi
source:
Class: 3-D
Favorite food: Coffee (she likes grinding the beans by herself), tart-like pastries
Hobbies: Exploring hot springs, photographing
Troubles: She doesn't have any pubic hair.

The serious student council president and one of the fencing club's top 3 members who is also one year older than her childhood friend [url=/c78241]Yuuya[/url]. Though she acts like a fawning older sister, she is always worried after him and can't say no to any kind of request.

She is best friends with [url=/c8478]Ayame[/url], and is always worried over her airheaded nature.
